action.objective: Verify kingside castling (e1g1) as the consolidation move after ...Bb4, checking whether the c3 knight pin and Black's play create tactical problems.
action.rationale: Broad search at depth 3 gave e1g1 the top exact score 58 with a clean PV (O-O, O-O, Qd2, Bxc3, Qxc3), and it is the reserved suggestion. Castling removes the king from the center, connects rooks and legally resolves nothing but improves king safety; it also sidesteps the awkward pin on c3 since Qd2/Qxc3 recaptures. No exact candidate_comparisons exist, so I verify this single candidate at full depth 4 before committing.
